newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Adana aims 2.3 mln T cement output.
newsitem.headline: Turk Adana aims 2.3 mln T cement output.

text.p: Turkish cement maker Adana Cimento is targeting to produce and sell 2.278 million tonnes of cement in 1997, the company said in a statement sent to Istanbul Stock Exchange.
The company's cement output was 1.475 million tonnes and sales were 1.470 million tonnes in 1996.

Adana Cimento's 1997 targets also include the production and sale of 1.167 million square metres of concrete, after 980,391 square metres in 1996. It also plans to sell 324,200 tonnes of clinker, after 238,030 tonnes last year.
The company's investment spending is set at 1.72 trillion lira for this year, down from 5.14 trillion in 1996.
Turkey's total cement output was 35.2 million tonnes in 1996. Thus Adana's share was 4.2 percent.
The managing board of Adana Cimento decided to raise the capital to 4.64 trillion lira from 2.44 trillion, it said in a separate statement.
Adana will issue 0.57 right and 0.33 bonus for each existing share. The shareholders may use their 1996 dividend payments in getting the rights shares.
The board decided to propose a 78.47 percent dividend for A series shares, 55.8 percent for B series and 7.75 percent for C series to the annual meeting of shareholders and directors on March 31.
The 1996 financial results of the company have not been disclosed yet.
